Jikana
writer on dh. Q. by Śūlapāṇi (in Tithi, Durgotsava, Prāyaścitta an. Śrāddhavivekas. See RASB.

an. JASB. (NS) XI (1915) p. 338); by Raghunandana in Śuddhitattva (Smṛtitattva, Jīvānanda Vidyasagar edn. Vol. II. p. 237); by Jīmūtavāhana (JBORS. VI (1920) p. 57); by Trimalla in Smṛtiratnāvalī; an. in Prāyaścittamayūkha.
--Anumaraṇaviveka. Q. by Raghunandana in Śuddhitattva.
--Antyeṣṭividhi. Q. by Raghunandana in Śuddhitattva (Smṛtitattva p. 237).
See JASB (NS) XI (1915) p. 366. See also Jikanīyanibandha below.

Jikanasaṅgraha
dh. Q. by Raghunandana in Tithitattva (Smṛtitattva p. 66).
See Poona Ori. XXI. p. 84.

Jikanīyanibandha
or jIAnibandha (?) dh. Q. by Caṇḍeśvara Ṭhakkura in Kṛtyaratnākara.
See JASB (NS) XI (1915) p. 382 an. NCC. IV. p. 278a. See also Jikana above. [Page247-a.
